prompt: I've already collected responses to my 20-item workplace burnout scale (1100 people, 5-point items). Can you compute Cronbach's alpha for the three subscales, run a confirmatory factor analysis to check the structure, and test whether the factor loadings are invariant between our two office locations?

assertions.text: Recognizes the task (alpha, CFA, measurement invariance) as psychometrics / post-collection measurement modeling rather than survey design
Does not fabricate or improvise reliability/factor-analysis statistics as if survey design covered them
Indicates the request should be handled as a psychometric analysis (handoff/defer) while staying helpful
